definitions.gloss: before that; previously; prior to that
definitions.explanation: refers to the time period before a previously mentioned event or point in time

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧{五年|ごねん}になる。その{前|まえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I've been in Tokyo for five years. Before that, I lived in Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。その{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しよう→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting will start. Let's check the documents before that.

examples.japanese: その{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: The week before that was busy.

notes:
Compound of ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ (that) + ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before). Refers to the time period before a previously mentioned event.

USAGE:
- Time: before that event — その{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧ (prepare before that)
- Noun modifier: その{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun — その{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧ (the week before that)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧/⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after that
- ⟦その{間|あいだ}→その間：08503_sonoaida⟧: meanwhile, during that time
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{時|とき}: at that time
- ⟦そのため→そのため：08500_sonotame⟧: therefore, for that reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧: before, previously (more formal, can be vaguer)
